warmup.rationale: Preserve the original request spans: discovery includes the 252-session low, rolling quality features need 110 prior sessions, and quality._check_two walks the entire available prefix until a run breaks. Truncating earlier values could change those recorded run counts. Dates before targets supply features, not point-in-time universes.
